title: Eudia and Harbor Partner to Accelerate AI Transformation for Enterprise Legal Teams
ai_summary: Eudia and Harbor announced a strategic partnership to help enterprise legal teams adopt Eudia's augmented intelligence platform. Harbor will provide advisory, implementation, training, and adoption enablement, leveraging its experience with over 600 corporate law departments and 80% of Global 200 firms. The collaboration aims to shorten the path from AI adoption to reliance.
